provenance: Excerpted without rerunning from the completed same-date Analysis experiment. Other unrelated experiments and local operational paths omitted.
method: Parse captured original Python with AST. Compile unchanged EnforceResult, UserInspection, Skip, Stop and InvokeAction classes against explicit Action and Enforcement doubles; exclude imports and untested LLM handlers.
question: Does the captured synchronous inspection method re-prompt on repeated calls and distinguish denial from Stop?
type: Source-derived isolated function probe; no full-system reproduction

cases.name: same-action-retry
cases.meaning: The isolated handler re-prompts on each invocation. This does not establish executor retry behavior or effect deduplication.

cases.name: alias-after-return
cases.meaning: Mutable Action double demonstrates unchanged method returns the same object. No concurrent production mutation was reproduced.

limits: Action and Enforcement are doubles. Pydantic, LangChain, full RuleInterpreter, Kyvvu engine, tools, external effects, concurrency and restart are not executed. Same-reference observation is conditional on the mutable double.
